{{Quote|Woyunoks hadzuska koshûjontû.|First line of the incantation|<ref name="BOS" />}}
'''''Dwomutsiqsa''''' (meaning "Summon Demon" in [[Sith (language)|Sith]]) was an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] incantation that summoned a manifestation of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] known as the [[Smoke Demon]].

==Description==
The ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ritual of Dwomutsiqsa was written on [[Sith scroll/Legends|scrolls]]. Through this incantation, the caster would concentrate the air and the energy around them to conjure a dreambeast known as the [[Smoke Demon]]. This creature had no true form, and it would assumed the shape of its victim's worst fear.

When read aloud by an imprudent user, this spell released malevolence as a safeguard against them who wished to unravel the mystery of the scrolls.

==History==
[[Sorzus Syn]], one of the twelve high-ranking [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were [[Exiles|exiled]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], found a scroll featuring the Dwomutsiqsa on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. In a chronicle she wrote on her encounters with the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], she provided a partial translation of the full text.
